title: Agentic Economy
description: AI enters the economy in the form of agents that participate in production, coordination, exchange, and governance.
intro: This track organizes work on economies where AI agents are active participants rather than passive tools, covering production, labor, markets, institutions, and macro implications.

readingPaths.title: Concept route
readingPaths.label: Production → labor → markets
steps: Begin with AI agents as production factors.
Then study labor and organizational change.
Finally open markets and governance for system design questions.

readingPaths.title: Policy route
readingPaths.label: Markets → institutions → macro
steps: Start from pricing, matching, and platform rules.
Move to regulation and governance questions.
End with macro and welfare implications.

subcategories.title: AI Agents as Production Factors
subcategories.description: Research on AI agents as productive inputs, knowledge capital, digital workers, or complementary infrastructure inside production systems.
recommendation: Relate micro tasks to aggregate productivity.

papers.title: Curated Slot: AI Agents in Production Systems
papers.abstract: Use this slot for studies on capability accumulation, task decomposition, and production effects when agents become reusable productive assets.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Skills and Memory as Digital Capital
papers.abstract: Suitable for work on treating skills, memory, or workflow traces as tradable and accumulable digital production factors.

subcategories.title: Labor Markets and Organizational Change
subcategories.description: How AI agents reshape occupations, firm boundaries, workflows, supervision, and human–AI team structures.
recommendation: Frame labor effects at the task level first.
Then discuss coordination and managerial redesign.
Separate short-run adjustment from long-run restructuring.

papers.title: Curated Slot: AI Agents and Labor Market Adjustment
papers.abstract: Use this card for work on displacement, augmentation, task redesign, and the changing composition of labor demand.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Human–AI Workflow Reorganization
papers.abstract: Suitable for studies of management, supervision, delegation, and modular organizational design around agents.

subcategories.title: Markets, Pricing, and Coordination
subcategories.description: How markets adapt when AI agents produce, negotiate, price, match, and trade over digital assets, labor, or services.
recommendation: Start from market objects: tasks, data, memory, or skills.
Then define matching and pricing rules.
Finally specify verification and governance constraints.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Market Design in Agentic Economies
papers.abstract: Best for papers on pricing, matching, settlement, platform rules, and transaction verification in agent-to-agent markets.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Pricing Newly Generated Digital Assets
papers.abstract: Suitable for research on valuing skills, memory, data products, or workflow outputs generated by autonomous agents.

subcategories.title: Institutions, Governance, and Regulation
subcategories.description: Policy and governance questions raised by autonomous agents interacting in markets, organizations, and public systems.
recommendation: Clarify who is responsible for agent actions.
Differentiate platform governance from public regulation.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Governing Agentic Economic Systems
papers.abstract: Use this slot for work on institutional design, compliance, safety, standards, and governance frameworks for autonomous economic agents.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Verification and Trust in Agent Markets
papers.abstract: Suitable for studies on certificates, auditing, market oversight, and transaction enforceability in multi-agent platforms.

subcategories.title: Macroeconomic and Welfare Implications
subcategories.description: Aggregate growth, productivity, distribution, and welfare consequences of economies with increasingly autonomous AI agents.
recommendation: Connect micro deployment mechanisms to aggregate outcomes.
Document transition frictions and redistribution channels.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Macroeconomics of Agentic Systems
papers.abstract: Ideal for modeling papers on productivity, growth, inequality, and welfare under widespread deployment of autonomous agents.

papers.title: Curated Slot: Distributional Effects of Autonomous Labor
papers.abstract: Suitable for research on redistribution, labor-income shares, and policy response to agent-driven productivity change.
